name: Getting To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that entrance into heaven is only possible through a spiritual rebirth, as Jesus teaches that one must be born again to see the kingdom of God (John 3:3). This new life comes by grace through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6; Ephesians 2:8). Belief in Christ's resurrection and confessing Him as Lord are essential for salvation and eternal life (Romans 10:9; John 3:16). Thus, heaven is granted not by human effort but as a gift received through faith in Jesus alone.
